tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: We've been talking about the different roles that museums play in society, such as promoting learning, protecting important objects, and sharing culture and knowledge. There are many types of museums: art museums, history museums, science museums, and many more. Imagine your community is planning to open a new museum and is asking residents to suggest what type it should be. What type of museum would you choose, and why? Please explain your reasoning.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I would choose a transportation museum, like one that focuses on trains, boats, and local buses. It can teach visitors things like how people used to travel and what types of vehicles they used. People who are interested in engineering can learn about how older technology functioned.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I think a museum that focuses on local history would be the most valuable for my community. The museum can display items like old street photos and diaries from residents. This type of museum collects personal stories before they disappear, which helps residents form a shared identity.
